E15.description: Base trough flood float switch triggered. Water detected in base pan activating safety microswitch and running drain pump continuously.
initial_steps: Disconnect 120V/240V mains branch circuit breaker immediately to halt continuous drain pump overrun.
Turn off under-sink water supply shutoff stopcock feeding the dishwasher braided supply line.
Remove lower toe-kick access cover panel and visually inspect base pan sump trough for standing water.
Sponge, syphon, or wet-vacuum accumulated moisture from the base pan to allow the styrofoam float disc to reset down.
Inspect sump perimeter O-ring gasket, water inlet valve solenoid seal, and circulation pump housing for weep traces.

E24.description: Drain pump sequence timeout or drain circuit flow restriction detected during cycle initiation.
initial_steps: Remove lower dish rack and rotate stainless steel microfilter cylinder counter-clockwise to lift out filter basket assembly.
Pry out white plastic drain pump impeller cover using Torx T20 screwdriver or integral pull tab.
Inspect BLDC drain pump impeller vanes for trapped debris such as glass shards, toothpicks, fruit seeds, or plastic ties.
Verify drain pump impeller spins with magnetic resistance (rotates in 90-degree tactile detents without dragging).
Inspect rubber non-return flapper check valve adjacent to impeller to confirm it is not stiffened, warped, or stuck closed.

E25.description: Drain pump impeller blocked or drain pump cover missing, unseated, or locked detent disengaged.
initial_steps: Verify white plastic drain pump impeller cover is firmly snapped into place with audible mechanical detent engagement.
Inspect drain hose routing under kitchen sink for kinks, crushing against cabinet backboard, or missing high drain loop (minimum 32-inch elevation).
Inspect kitchen garbage disposal drain inlet barb to verify knockout plug was removed during installation.
Measure drain pump motor winding resistance across terminal pins with digital multimeter (nominal 85 to 105 Ohms).
MANDATORY HALT: If impeller motor winding shows open circuit or shorted coil, disconnect power and dispatch Authorized Field Technician for BLDC drain pump replacement.

E27.description: Line voltage drop below threshold (< 98V AC) under flow-through water heater or heat pump load.
initial_steps: Measure AC line voltage at wall receptacle using calibrated True-RMS multimeter under resting state (nominal 120V AC +/- 10%).
Verify dishwasher is hardwired on dedicated 15A/20A branch circuit and not daisy-chained through downstream GFCI outlets or extension cords.
Inspect rear metal power junction box behind toe-kick panel for loose wire nuts, terminal screw oxidation, or thermal scorching.
Monitor line voltage drop when heater relay energizes; if supply dips below 98V AC, contact certified facility electrician to resolve supply feed impedance.

F06 E01.description: Drive motor tachometer failure. ACU/MCU detects no rotational tachometer feedback pulses from 3-phase induction or PMSM motor during active drive command.
initial_steps: Disconnect AC line power cord and wait 3 minutes for MCU inverter bus capacitors to safely bleed down below 50V DC.
Enter Service Diagnostic Mode on console by selecting any 3 keys and pressing in sequence: 1-2-3, 1-2-3, 1-2-3 within 8 seconds.
Inspect 3-wire tachometer wiring harness between MCU connector J9 and motor endbell sensor connector for pinched or broken leads.
Rotate inner stainless wash basket manually by hand to verify smooth drum spin without mechanical bearing binding or foreign object friction.
Measure tachometer coil resistance across pins 1 and 2 of the motor harness connector (nominal 115 to 130 Ohms at 20 C / 68 F).
MANDATORY HALT: Direct drive stator winding continuity check or motor control inverter replacement requires Authorized Field Technician.

F03 E01.description: Analog Pressure Sensor (APS) fault or pressure signal frequency out of valid operating range (< 20 kHz or > 46 kHz).
initial_steps: Disconnect AC line power cord from wall outlet.
Remove top console / cabinet lid to access the Analog Pressure Sensor mounted on the upper chassis side rail.
Inspect translucent vinyl air pressure tube connecting pressure transducer to lower tub sump air bell dome.
Check vinyl pressure tube for kinks, pinching, punctures, condensation blockages, or detergent residue cakes.
Disconnect vinyl tube at sensor nipple, blow gently down the tube toward tub sump to clear any debris, and verify clear airway.
Verify ACU connector J3 harness seating and inspect DC supply voltage (nominal 5.0 VDC between pins 1 and 3).

F08 E01.description: Wash water heater drive circuit failure or heating element open circuit detected during sanitary or steam cycle.
initial_steps: Disconnect AC line power cord; remove rear service access panel to expose heating element terminals at tub base.
Discharge electrostatic potential and inspect heating element terminals and harness wiring for thermal discoloration or loose slip-on spades.
Measure resistance across heating element terminals with digital multimeter (nominal 12 to 18 Ohms for 120V element; open circuit confirms element failure).
Measure insulation resistance from either heater terminal to tub chassis metal ground (must read greater than 10 Megohms).
MANDATORY HALT: Replacing failed tubular wash heating element or ACU heater drive relay requires Authorized Field Technician.

BLNK-5.description: Inverter Linear Compressor locked rotor detection (5 LED blinks on Main Inverter PCB). Compressor fails to reciprocate due to piston seizure or drive circuit phase loss.
initial_steps: Disconnect AC power cord and observe mandatory 3-minute PCB capacitor bleed-down delay before removing rear machine compartment cover.
Locate the red diagnostic LED on the Main Inverter PCB; verify blink cadence (5 rapid 0.5-second flashes followed by 2-second pause).
Remove compressor 3-pin lead terminal cover and inspect connector pins for heat damage, burning, or carbonization.
Measure linear compressor stator coil resistance across compressor terminal pins U and V (nominal 6.0 to 11.0 Ohms).
Measure insulation resistance from terminal pins to compressor shell ground (must exceed 5 Megohms).
MANDATORY HALT: Linear compressor sealed system repair involves flammable R600a Isobutane refrigerant isolation and torch/flameless lokring brazing. Requires EPA Universal Certified Field Technician.

BLNK-6.description: Compressor drive current trip or IPM (Intelligent Power Module) overcurrent protection engaged (6 LED blinks on Main Inverter PCB).
initial_steps: Disconnect refrigerator AC power cord and observe 3-minute PCB bleed-down delay before servicing rear electrical compartment.
Inspect rear machine compartment condenser fan motor assembly; verify fan blade spins freely without debris or wire harness fouling.
Clean wire condenser heat exchanger matrix using high-velocity vacuum brush to remove heavy lint accumulation.
Check Main Inverter PCB IPM aluminum heat sink mounting screws for thermal paste dry-out or loose mechanical torque.
Inspect compressor discharge line temperature to ensure thermal overload protector has not permanently tripped open.
MANDATORY HALT: Inverter drive board replacement, IPM power bridge testing, or shorted linear compressor stator replacement requires Authorized Field Technician.

DH-ERR.description: Defrost heater cycle timeout. Evaporator defrost sensor fails to reach defrost termination threshold temperature (8 C / 46 F) within 80 minutes of heater activation.
initial_steps: Inspect rear evaporator cover wall inside freezer compartment for heavy frost blanket, ice bulging, or airflow duct choking.
Initiate Forced Defrost mode from front dispenser panel by holding 'Refrigerator' and 'Ice Plus' keys simultaneously for 3 seconds.
Disconnect AC line power cord; remove freezer back wall panel to expose aluminum defrost sheath heater.
Measure defrost sheath heater resistance across harness connector pins (nominal 80 to 120 Ohms; open indicates broken heater element).
Test defrost bimetal safety thermostat / thermal fuse continuity (must read 0 Ohms closed at freezing temperature; infinite indicates tripped safety fuse).
Measure defrost NTC temperature sensor resistance (nominal 30k Ohms at 0 C / 32 F; 10k Ohms at 25 C / 77 F).

Er01.description: Steam boiler water fill timeout. Conductive water level sensor probe fails to detect water level continuity within 90 seconds of fill solenoid engagement.
initial_steps: Verify rear water reservoir is filled with filtered water and magnetic float in reservoir channel floats freely to top of travel.
Inspect water reservoir mesh intake valve and silicone duckbill gasket in machine floor for calcium scale obstruction or displacement.
Power off machine, unplug from 120V/240V AC supply, and verify both rear boiler manual brass ball drain valves are turned fully horizontal (closed).
Inspect conductive water level probe harness wire on top of steam boiler; verify faston spade connector is tight and free of green corrosion.
Listen for ULKA vibratory fill pump operation during startup cycle; if pump hums without priming, perform manual suction prime via water intake port.

Er02.description: Grouphead thermal runaway error. Grouphead collar NTC temperature sensor reads greater than 105 C (221 F) for more than 5 consecutive seconds.
initial_steps: Unplug machine power cord from wall receptacle immediately to prevent thermal fuse blow and steam boiler overpressure.
Allow espresso machine to cool down completely to ambient room temperature (minimum 45 minutes).
Remove top chassis lid (6 Torx T10 screws) while observing mandatory 15-bar pressurized steam boiler scalding warning.
Inspect grouphead cartridge heating element wiring and NTC thermistor leads for insulation chafe, silicone sheath splits, or shorting to brass collar.
Measure grouphead NTC thermistor resistance at 25 C / 77 F (nominal 50k Ohms across pins).
MANDATORY HALT: Grouphead solid-state relay (SSR) triac breakdown, power PCB short, or cartridge heater replacement requires Authorized Field Technician.

Er03.description: Steam boiler NTC thermistor sensor open circuit or disconnected sensor harness detected during power-on self-test.
initial_steps: Unplug espresso machine from AC power socket and ensure steam boiler pressure gauge reads 0 bar.
Remove top chassis lid and inspect 2-pin white Molex harness connector on Main Power Board labeled 'NTC-STM'.
Verify wiring harness from steam boiler sensor well to main board has not been pinched by internal chassis structural ribs.
Measure NTC thermistor resistance directly across sensor probe terminals (nominal 50k Ohms at 25 C / 77 F; infinite indicates open circuit).
MANDATORY HALT: Replacing threaded NTC thermistor sensor probe in high-pressure steam boiler vessel requires Authorized Field Technician with PTFE thread sealant.
